# salucallc/.github

> Organization-wide community health defaults for salucallc GitHub repos: security policy, contributing guide, code of conduct, issue and pull request templates, and the organization profile. MIT licence.

GitHub shows these files in any salucallc repo that has no file of the same type; a repo's own file always wins. They do not apply to saluca-labs repos. There is no code, no CODEOWNERS and no workflows here; reusable CI lives in salucallc/ci-shared.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/salucallc/.github/blob/main/README.md): what is provided and how GitHub applies it
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/salucallc/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability (security@saluca.com), scope, safe harbour
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/salucallc/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to propose a change
- [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/salucallc/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): conduct standards and where to report (conduct@saluca.com)

## Templates

- [Bug report](https://github.com/salucallc/.github/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md): default bug issue template
- [Feature request](https://github.com/salucallc/.github/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md): default feature issue template
- [Pull request template](https://github.com/salucallc/.github/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md): default PR description

## Optional

- [Organization profile](https://github.com/salucallc/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md): the text on github.com/salucallc
- [salucallc/ci-shared](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared): reusable GitHub Actions workflows
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/salucallc/.github/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents editing this repo
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/salucallc/.github/blob/main/llms-full.txt): this header plus every file above in full
